visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a studio setting with a world map background, a man in a white t-shirt and blue jeans is sitting in a black office chair. He holds his left shoulder with his right hand, tilting his head with an expression of physical discomfort and fatigue. Bright studio lighting illuminates his face and the ergonomic chair. (2) The man leans his head back against the chair's headrest, closing his eyes in a gesture of momentary relief. He wears a thin black microphone cable around his neck. The background features various city names like 'Beijing' and 'Shenyang' on the map wall. (3) The scene shifts to the man sitting upright at a wooden desk, using a white keyboard and mouse. He looks towards a computer screen out of frame while explaining posture. The lighting remains consistent and bright, highlighting the texture of his cotton shirt and the metallic microphone stand to his right. (4) A close-up view shows the man's hand sliding into the empty space between his lower back and the office chair, demonstrating the lack of support. He points to his waist area to emphasize the point. The chair has a mesh back and a blue cushioned seat. (5) The man holds up a white-framed Roichen back support cushion with black pads. He rotates it to show its curved, ergonomic shape. In the background, a small inset video appears briefly showing two performers on a stage. (6) The man demonstrates the product by placing it on his chair and sitting on it, showing how it pushes his back forward into a straighter posture. He uses hand gestures to explain the structural support provided by the product. (7) Multiple versions of the product in red, grey, and black are shown in a clean, studio-lit shot. The man continues his narration, pointing at the different sizes and colors suitable for men, women, and children. (8) The final scene displays a large QR code on the screen next to the man, who is giving a thumbs-up. He holds the product in his other hand. The shot then cuts to a static product image of a 'DeoHome' cleaning stick against a white and yellow background.
